patch.value: Expand pm-web coverage gate to every executable source file and all four 100% metrics

The current release:check passed 408 real-Postgres and other tests, but coverage-gate reported only 32 source files with several measured branch/function percentages below 100. This does not meet the requested all-source 100/100/100/100 quality gate. The existing pm-web-9ulj issue specifically owns route-layer real-Postgres integration; this item owns gate scope and all four metrics across every executable source file.

Measure and require 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines for every executable source file; retain real integration and route tests; fail when a file is omitted or coverage data is missing; avoid artificial tests or coverage exclusions.
pm-web PR #163 release:check 2026-09-29; coverage-gate 32 reported source files
npm run coverage; inspect the per-file coverage table and scripts/coverage-gate.ts source inclusion and thresholds.
All executable TypeScript source files are included and statements, branches, functions, and lines each measure 100% through real behavior tests.
Current gate says thresholds met for 32 source files while several per-file metrics are below 100 and executable source outside that declared set is unmeasured.
